title: Zoning text change to add affordable housing rules for Monitor Point, Greenpoint
summary: This zoning text amendment establishes a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area and related height, bulk and loading provisions for the Monitor Point mixed-use development on the Greenpoint waterfront in Brooklyn Community District 1. It works together with related zoning map, special permit and City Map actions to allow about 1,150 residential units, including 300 permanently income-restricted units, plus commercial and community facility space. The City Council held a public hearing on May 27, 2026 and the Land Use Committee approved the measure on June 25, 2026.
